page_title: MON 4-2 ACM | Monza v AC Milan 18/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' 4 - 2 Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) takes a great first touch to control a killer pass on the edge of the box and drills a shot into the bottom right corner in trademark fashion.
90+2' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
90+1' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Monza players have a reason to celebrate!
90+1' Wait! Referee Andrea Colombo has indicated he is going to review the Monza goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' 3 - 2 Warren Bondo (Monza) collects a good pass and slams the ball from mid-range into the top right corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance.
88' 2 - 2 Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball inside the left post.
86' Monza force a corner. They send men into the box.
86' The referee signals a corner kick to Monza.
83' Substitution. Yunus Musah (AC Milan) has come on for Alessandro Florenzi.
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Andrea Colombo didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
81' Here is a change. Andrea Colpani is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Pedro Pereira (Monza).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Dany Mota leaves the pitch and Daniel Maldini (Monza) comes on.

79' Ruben Loftus-Cheek (AC Milan) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Alessandro Sorrentino shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
76' Warren Bondo (Monza) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
76' Dany Mota (Monza) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
76' Monza quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

75' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Samuele Birindelli (Monza) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Mike Maignan pulls off a brilliant save.
74' Monza keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
72' Pablo Mari (Monza) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Andrea Colombo saw the whole situation.

70' It looked like the long-range shot by Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) would end up in the net, but the effort went painfully wide of the right post. The goalkeeper was quite lucky this time. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
68' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
66' Raffaele Palladino decides to make a substitution. Milan Djuric will be replaced by Lorenzo Colombo (Monza).
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Warren Bondo (Monza) will replace Valentin Carboni.
64' 2 - 1 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Christian Pulisic and Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 2:1.
64' Some neat passing and movement from AC Milan as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
61' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) was too forceful with his tackle and Andrea Colombo interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
61' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
61' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
57' Monza will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
57' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Dany Mota (Monza), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
56' Matteo Pessina (Monza) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andrea Colombo has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
55' Monza take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
54' Ismael Bennacer goes off the pitch and Olivier Giroud (AC Milan) comes on.
53' After VAR review the ref signals the yellow card is cancelled but now issues a red. Luka Jovic (AC Milan) has to leave the pitch!
51' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident from earlier. This could be a red card for Luka Jovic (AC Milan)! Let's see what he decides.
50' Raffaele Palladino appears to have said too much and referee Andrea Colombo comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
50' Andrea Colombo shows a yellow card to Luka Jovic (AC Milan) for his blatant foul.

49' Ambitious effort from Christian Pulisic (AC Milan). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well over the bar.
46' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Noah Okafor walks off the pitch to be replaced by Rafael Leao (AC Milan).
46' Half-time substitution. Stefano Pioli decided to make a change. Yacine Adli (AC Milan) is replaced by Tijjani Reijnders.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Stefano Pioli gives a chance to Christian Pulisic and Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) is off.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+10' The end of the first half.

45+9' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) sends a direct shot in from the free kick that's in a promising position. The ball sails towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper prevents a goal with a quick save.
45+8' Matteo Pessina (Monza) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.

45+6' 2 - 0 GOAL! A great pass finds Dany Mota (Monza) in acres of space after a fine counter attack. He brings the ball under control before firing it past the helpless keeper from close range. It’s now 2:0.
45+5' Andrea Colombo has a clear sight and sees a foul from Milan Djuric (Monza).
45+5' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) gets to a rebound inside the goalmouth, but even from this distance he misses the target and fails to score. The ball goes out of play and Monza will have a goal kick.
45+5' Wow, what an escape. Luka Jovic (AC Milan) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
45+4' It looks like Dany Mota (Monza) saw red with that tackle. Andrea Colombo won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
45' We will have 8 min. of added time.
45' 1 - 0 Goal! Matteo Pessina (Monza) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Mike Maignan to commit before slotting the penalty low into the middle of the goal.
45' Matteo Pessina (Monza) is going to take the penalty!
45' Referee Andrea Colombo is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Monza!
44' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Monza as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
44' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul. Joy for one side, despair for the other as the referee gives a penalty to Monza!
43' Andrea Carboni (Monza) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
43' Alessandro Sorrentino takes to the field as the replacement for Michele Di Gregorio (Monza), who couldn’t continue due to his head injury.
37' Michele Di Gregorio (Monza) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
37' The game is interrupted now, Andrea Carboni (Monza) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
36' Yacine Adli (AC Milan) sends the corner into the box, but Michele Di Gregorio intercepts it and averts the threat.
36' Luka Jovic (AC Milan) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
33' Milan Djuric (Monza) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.
32' Alessandro Florenzi (AC Milan) makes a rough challenge and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Milan Djuric (Monza) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
30' A pass from Noah Okafor (AC Milan) is intercepted by Michele Di Gregorio and the move breaks down.
28' AC Milan hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.

25' Andrea Carboni (Monza) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mike Maignan pulls off an easy save.
25' Andrea Colombo couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) and blew his whistle.
24' The current number of corner kicks is 2:1.
24' Ismael Bennacer (AC Milan) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!

21' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the middle of the target, but Michele Di Gregorio was alert and the score remains the same.
19' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
18' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' A cross into the box from Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) is cleared.
15' Valentin Carboni (Monza) makes a strong challenge and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
13' The percentage of ball possession is – 39:61.
9' Dany Mota (Monza) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
9' AC Milan are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
7' Andrea Colombo blows for a foul after Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
5' AC Milan can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
5' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
4' Monza have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
4' Pablo Mari (Monza) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Pablo Mari (Monza) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
4' Monza take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
3' Dany Mota (Monza) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
2' Luka Jovic (AC Milan) connects with the resultant free kick but produces a header straight at Michele Di Gregorio.
1' Matteo Pessina (Monza) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Andrea Colombo blows for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and AC Milan will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Andrea Colombo.
